title: Truck Country’s Wausau and Minocqua locations add Western Star brand

body:
Western Star welcomes new generation vocational truck

It continues to be an exciting time for Truck Country! We are pleased to announce Truck Country’s Wausau and Minocqua locations are now officially Western Star Trucks dealership locations, effective immediately.

In addition to continuing to serve as an authorized dealership for new Freightliner trucks, we are excited to have the opportunity to market Western Star’s great lineup of new over-the-road and vocational trucks to our Central Wisconsin customers.

The Wausau and Minocqua branches join 14 other Western Star dealerships operated by Truck Country and Stoops Freightliner-Quality Trailer in Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Ohio and Wisconsin.

Now is especially an ideal time to for Truck Country to expand its relationship with the Western Star brand. In late September, Western Star introduced its next-generation truck, the all-new 49X, which the manufacturer promises will revolutionize the vocational market.

For more information about the addition of the Western Star brands to Truck Country’s Wausau and Minocqua product offerings, please contact Justin Gleiter at justingleiter@truckcountry.com.
